# GO TOKYO Tickets

> > Official ticket booking platform for Tokyo tourism, offering access to cultural events, attractions, and experiences including kabuki, sumo, Tokyo Skytree, and traditional crafts.

GO TOKYO Tickets is the official ticketing service for Tokyo tourism, providing visitors with convenient booking for major attractions, cultural experiences, and tourist passes. The platform features THE TOKYO PASS and Tokyo City Pass for unlimited access to transportation and popular destinations across Tokyo's key districts including Asakusa, Shinjuku, Ginza, and Marunouchi.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo City Pass
- THE TOKYO PASS
- Tokyo Skytree
- Asakusa cultural experiences
- Subway travel passes
- Traditional crafts workshops
- Tokyo attractions and sightseeing
- Event tickets (kabuki, sumo, J.LEAGUE)
- SusHi Tech Tokyo 2026
- Tokyo Big Sight events
- Shinjuku and Ginza districts
- Walking tours and guided experiences
- Japan National Stadium
- Discount tickets for tourists
- Cultural activities and artisan workshops

## Tourist Passes & Access Cards

- [Tokyo City Pass](https://www.tickets.gotokyo.org/en/about_tokyo_city_pass/): Tokyo City Pass info: attractions access (Skytree, Tower, teamLab)
- [THE TOKYO PASS](https://www.tickets.gotokyo.org/en/about_tokyo_pass): THE TOKYO PASS: unlimited subway & museum access tourist pass

## Cultural Experiences & Activities

- [More Experiences](https://www.tickets.gotokyo.org/en/tickets/more_experiences): Cultural experiences: Edo crafts, Asakusa tours, artisan workshops

## Home & Overview

- [Tokyo Events and Tickets](https://www.tickets.gotokyo.org/): Homepage for official Tokyo tourism ticket booking (kabuki, sumo, events)
